answer: Give every newcomer a mirrored apprenticeship: before trading, it must finish public tasks in a violet-hour window while an independent mirror ledger records each step. Peers compare fingerprints; if two identities share the same pigment pattern, only the earliest keeps credit and the later is suspended for review. Real agents diverge naturally, while a Sybil farm reusing one script leaves matching mirror traces that expose it.
